svg.title: Figure29 Authorization Decision State Continuity Model
svg.desc: NEW-shot2play Protocol Suite Version 2.0. Authorization Decision lifecycle and state continuity model from request through evaluation, authorization, enforcement, consumption and completion, including denial, revocation, expiration, failure and controlled reauthorization.
svg.text: Figure29 Authorization Decision State Continuity Model
Authorization is a controlled lifecycle, not merely a point-in-time ALLOW / DENY result.
Decision State + Context Binding + Scope + Time + Consumption
Every security-sensitive state transition remains correlated to the applicable decision context.
Decision ID · Request ID · Subject ID · Entitlement ID · Policy ID · Transaction ID
Resource · Action · Scope · Issuer · Timestamp · Expiration · Revocation · Consumption
One Decision ID permits lifecycle-wide correlation and audit reconstruction.
Recovery SHALL NOT silently restore authority.
Decision State vs Security Context State
For how long / how many uses?
Completed SHALL NOT return to Authorized · Consumed SHALL NOT become Unconsumed
Revoked SHALL NOT silently become Authorized · Expired SHALL NOT silently become Active
Any restoration of authorization requires a new valid evaluation unless explicitly controlled by policy.
Audit: Decision ID · Previous State · New State · Reason · Actor · Service · Policy Version · Transaction · Timestamp · Correlation ID
